_about: freeze.json for the ONE scored run of studies/cycle-nowcast-v2.md (SPEC v1 + v1.1 + v1.2). Casey's answers of 2026-10-28: every field at the SPEC default carried by freeze_template.json; the August harness is not retrievable. Each _field note repeats the question the value answers. Validated with scoring.validate_freeze(require_frozen=True) on 2026-10-28; the run itself was NOT armed.
spec_version: SPEC v1 (2026-10-20) with the v1.1 and v1.2 amendments
_X_pct: Q1 (P1): comparator SUCCESS margin — IS-A ENS_HH RMSE within X% of calibrated real-time ADS (r <= 1 + X/100, ex-2020, 2013-06+ true vintages). SPEC default X = 10.
_Y_pct: Q1 (P1): comparator KILL margin — calibrated ADS beats ENS_HH by more than Y% RMSE (r > 1 + Y/100) AND one-sided DM (NW-6, p < 0.10) -> calibrated ADS becomes the headline. SPEC default Y = 25. Must exceed X.
_regime_scope: Q2 (P1): 'two_regimes_never_pooled' (true real-time 2013-06-14+, pseudo-real-time 2000-01..2013-05 from list-proxy issue points) or 'regime_i_only'. SPEC default: two regimes, never pooled.
_shutdown_rule: Q3 (P1): lag >= 4 member rule. Implemented: 'drop_and_remean' (dropped and the mean re-taken, flagged, wide band). 'pooled_ge3' / 'carry_forward' are NOT implemented: choosing them refuses the run until the engine and SPEC are amended. SPEC default: drop-and-re-mean.
_fixture_policy: Q4 (P1): gate on the frozen 2026-08-07 fixture (F1), score on the new frozen pull (F5), both reported in the honesty box. Only this policy is implemented. SPEC default: yes.
_harness_status: Q5 (P1): the August harness. 'not_retrievable' keeps G04 / Q01 / Q04 as DESCRIPTIVE per v1.1 (soft, recorded, not gated). 'retrieved' refuses the run: the ENS_GRID_REPRO count and the S/HH soft rows must first be re-gated against its selector tie-break. SPEC default: assumed not retrievable.
_comparator_calibration_store: Q16 — RULED 2026-10-20 (SPEC v1.2, spec owner): 'regime_i_stored_readings_symmetric_rows' — both sides calibrated on the STORED regime-(i) real-time readings at the same IS on identical rows; the first calibrated reading comes >= 24 stored months after the first regime-(i) row (~2015 on the real panel; D-3 n_ex2020 ~120, recorded with the warm-up in decision_D3.calibration_warmup). Seeding the ADS side from the 2008-12+ archive against a pseudo-real-time ENS is NOT done (the asymmetry v1 §5 forbids); choosing it refuses the run.
_target_first_agreement: Q17 — RULED 2026-10-20 (SPEC v1.2, spec owner): 'same_outcome_class' — the outcome class under target_first (same X/Y thresholds, one-sided DM on target_first errors) must equal the class under target_latest, else DEFERRED to the next R2; both classes are always recorded (decision_D3.class_under_target_first). 'sign_of_r_minus_1' remains implemented as a sensitivity reading only.
_board_contract: Q6 (P2): keep `coincident` partial and ADD `coincident_completed` (default) or replace the headline. Recorded only; no computation depends on it.
_information_sets: Q7 (P2): three information sets, IS-D dropped. Recorded only (the engine implements three).
_piger_rule: Q8 (P2): Chauvet-Piger rule 3x80%/3x20% primary with the 1-month >= 50% sensitivity (default). Both are always reported; this field says which is quoted as the cross-check text.
_comparator_metric: Q9 (P2): RMSE after walk-forward calibration primary, onsets secondary (default). Only this is implemented as the D-3 number.
_pre2009_claims: Q10 (P2): pre-2009 claims on final seasonal factors accepted with a caveat; the ICNSA + frozen-SA sensitivity is NOT run (v1 §8, F14). Recorded only.
_umcsent: Q11 (P2): flag UMCSENT's one-month FRED delay on the live board (default). Recorded only.
_silent_readings: Q12 (P3): accept the §1 readings of what the August doc left silent (default).
_fred_key: Q13 (P3): keyless ALFRED pulls (default); a key is a convenience only.
_benchmarks: Q14 (P3): CFNAI-MA3 / CEI / WEI as chart-only context (default).
_ads_readings: Q15 (P3, redefined per F06/DT-3): ADS_avg(M | d) is THE comparator reading, ADS_last(d) descriptive (default).
_f5_pull_date: The run day of the frozen F5 pull (YYYY-MM-DD); recorded into results.json.
freeze_note: Frozen 2026-10-28 against SPEC v1 + v1.1 + v1.2 (studies/cycle-nowcast-v2.md). Casey answered all defaults (Q1-Q15 as the template; Q16/Q17 as RULED in v1.2); Q5: the August harness is not_retrievable. F5 = data/fred_2026-10-28 (13 series, MANIFEST.json).
